findings.text: 为希望用自己的手机或另一台电脑继续操作同一 DSH 实例的用户，提供扫码配对、设备会话和远程官方Web界面通道。合格结果是正确设备能访问预期主机、未配对设备被拒绝且撤销后不能继续新请求；不是多用户隔离或只读共享。
PairingService维护短期token与持久设备表，/remote在HTTP和WS重发前核验设备，再使用内层凭据访问同一环回宿主。
抽读配对状态机、HTTP/WS网关、api/gate与宿主接线；未审计全部转发器、云relay、移动CSS或Service Worker，不运行隧道或配对。
monorepo子包 @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui，dsh bundle与web client；LAN和公网模式有不同依赖与信任路径。

#### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次使用 | 常驻宿主、LAN/隧道资源 | 配置来源、代理与设备配对，核对权限 | 费用、网络环境及耗时未测 | | 持续使用 | 代理流量、连接及可选外部relay | 设备审查、宿主升级兼容和界面复核 | 移动布局依赖官方语义选择器 | | 失败恢复 | 隧道重连、设备重配及存储修复 | 查通道状态、认证和残留访问 | 撤销不能自动回收宿主另发浏览器凭据 |
确有跨设备操作需要、理解配对等同主机控制的用户，可先在无敏感数据的实例测试自有设备。保持loopback宿主、先试LAN，再测未配对拒绝、撤销、重启和浏览器恢复；公网relay需单独接受中转方流量可见性。需要只读共享、多租户或统一撤销所有宿主凭据的场景先观察。[Q05](#research-q05)

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 界面复用 | 远程通道向同一环回宿主重发 | 手机实际可操作性与网络性能 |
| 设备访问门禁 | HTTP与WS握手均校验设备 | 在途长连接、代理和直接/api全覆盖 |
| 撤销持久化 | stop/revoke清表并保存，失败尝试移除旧文件 | 双重文件系统失败后的重启状态 |
先门禁再代理、区分loopback upstream与真实本机以及撤销持久失败时尝试移除旧store值得借鉴。需要保留本组件与宿主认证不同所有权，不能由局部fail-closed推断全部访问撤销。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
相对直接暴露宿主Web端口，它用独立 /remote 网关把设备凭据核验放在环回重发之前，复用官方界面并维护配对与持久设备生命周期。撤销写盘失败时尝试移除陈旧存储，避免重启恢复已撤销会话。贡献是受边界约束的远程控制交接，隧道、TLS和官方界面归属外部。[Q02](#research-q02)
配对设备实质持有广泛主机控制能力，且撤销只约束插件自己的配对通道；直接 /api 是否可达依赖宿主fence，gate.ts明确某运行时没有api/gate发射者。此外QR token在有效期内可重复兑换设备，package的one-time措辞不能覆盖实际状态机。应按实际通道与凭据区分撤销语义，不声称统一收回所有权限。[Q03](#research-q03)
未验证假设是将“设备已撤销”改为带通道覆盖的可回读结果：分别探测 /remote、原生 /api、WebSocket和在途请求，列明已切断、仍在途及宿主外凭据。由当前设备撤销与宿主认证分离推导，增量是可验证退出边界。用隔离实例对不同绑定、代理和已有浏览器凭据做矩阵实验；若无法可靠检测某路径就标未知，不用单个绿色状态替代。[Q05](#research-q05)

technical.rationale: novelty为已有Web界面与配对代理的适配；mechanism在设备生命周期、内外凭据和撤销持久化形成实质组合；transferability可复用门禁先于代理与撤销落盘设计；simplification复用官方界面但网络恢复仍复杂。未把TLS和外部隧道归为原创。

business.rationale: workflow把本机工作延伸至自有设备；delivery仍是相同宿主任务；reach增加移动访问入口但权限不分层；economics仅减少第二界面维护潜力，无用户时间或费用数据。

recommendation.reason: 有跨设备需要的用户可在无敏感实例和自有设备先测LAN、拒绝与撤销；不适合只读共享或统一权限治理。

scenario.rationale: 同实例跨设备场景明确，独立需求频率未核实。

advantage.rationale: 比直接暴露端口增加设备门禁并复用界面，远程桌面等替代仍存在。

evidence.rationale: 固定源码支持配对和代理，未运行设备与网络矩阵。

cost.rationale: 全控制凭据、代理、存储和外部relay引入较高维护与信任负担。

查看原文（11行） ```text > Seamless remote access for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and desktop client sharing the **exact same interface**: pair an iPhone, Android smartphone, tablet, or another computer from the QR code next to settings. Both ends run the authentic official Web GUI — phones receive an injected portrait touch layer while remote computers enjoy the complete desktop workbench. Access is guarded by expiring pairing tokens and revocable sessions. Built-in LAN binding and optional Cloudflare quick tunnels enable effortless external access with persistent hostnames. This package is an official external plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), structured as a cordis bundle: the host half manages pairing tokens, device sessions, `/api/pair` routes, the gated `/remote` channel, and LAN binding; the browser half renders the remote access trigger, QR pairing modal, live device roster, settings card, and mobile portrait touch adaptation. ## What it does - **Entry**: a phone icon beside the settings button in both the expanded sidebar and the narrow rail; its tooltip and accessible label say "Remote access". - **Panel**: "Remote access" title, a "Pair a device" card with the status area ("Waiting for a device" + status badge), a large QR code, the pairing link with its copy button, Stop / Refresh QR actions, and the authorized-device roster (a saved device name that falls back to the User-Agent-derived label, online/offline, last active time, per-device rename and unpair, and a merge action for rows sharing one User-Agent). Credential-bearing device ids and raw User-Agent values are never rendered. Both the phone and the PC use the same time-limited link: until it expires or the QR is refreshed, that link can pair several devices, each with its own device session. - **Phone side**: scanning the QR binds the phone with a time-limited token and reloads into the **official Web GUI** — there is no second interface to drift from. While the phone is in portrait, the plugin injects a touch-adaptation layer over the running UI (see "The mobile adaptation layer" below). The accept chain is cookieless (`/pair-accept` → `/pair-app`): the plugin itself serves the official shell, so the phone needs no harness browser-auth cookie at all. A reopen service worker (https origins) then owns later navigations to `/` from history, bookmarks, or tab restore, so the phone reopens straight into the app instead of a 401 dead end (see Security model). - **PC side**: the same link opens the full desktop Web GUI on another computer over the gated `/remote` channel; unpaired PCs see a guided blocking page (with a manual pair-token input) and no workspace data behind it. - **Security**: one active token at a time (a refresh invalidates the old link; the link stays re-usable within its expiry window so a scan handed between browsers can complete pairing; it expires). 停止 revokes every paired device and the current token — the `/remote` channel cuts them off on their next request. Pairing is this plugin's access control for the `/remote` channel; the web server keeps its loopback bind, so a LAN browser reaches the app through this plugin's gated `/remote` gateway (the client moves its transport there) rather than the native `/api`, which the harness Host fence answers with 403 for a LAN authority (see Security model). Loopback (127.0.0.1) keeps using `/api` directly, and so does a page an application on this machine delivered — the desktop shell's `dsh-app://app/` or a `file:` page — because a pairing link is reachable only over the network. A paired device is a **full-control credential** (see Security model). ```

A missing or revoked session receives HTTP 403 with a JSON rejection carrying `error.code: "unpaired"`; the browser's `EventSource` API exposes only the stream failure, not that response body.
